repairs.was: freestandingFraction = SOLITARY / INTRAMURAL BODIES (bodies alone in their closed-mask component, over drawn building subpaths)
repairs.now: freestandingDensity = MASSES / INTRAMURAL BUILDING-INK AREA, per 1,000 sq view units
repairs.why: F3 rose on the fusion tip (city 0.0652 → 0.0818). The ordered fix — count masses in the numerator — is a NO-OP: a body alone in its component IS a component holding one body, measured 133 = 133 at city and 140 = 140 at the tip. The inversion is in the DENOMINATOR: drawn subpaths are not conserved under generative fusion (city 2,045 → 1,717, −16.0 %), while the ink is (building fill 117,452 → 117,885 sq units, +0.37 %).
repairs.alsoChanged: F3 no longer reads through close(built, FUSE_R) — the radius REG-1 §4 showed bridges slots and packing wedges the charter says must remain — and it measures a new building-only mask, so no F1/F2 figure moves.

repairs.now: the leaf's own party-gap-resolving N: partyGap = plotFrontage × 0.035; N = smallest multiple of 200 with cell ≤ partyGap, capped at 6400 (REG-1 §4b, recorded before measuring)
repairs.why: Every party gap in the corpus is smaller than one 1400 cell (city 0.219 u, village 0.481 u), so the base plate arrived already fused BY RASTERISATION and the instrument could not see the defect it exists to measure.
repairs.alsoChanged: --reg0compat PINS 1400 so REG-0's published figures still reproduce exactly; --grid= still overrides; --circuit=<json> was added so the CLI can supply the model circuit the instrument already documents as PREFERRED.

i6Corpus.f3Formula: freestandingDensity = MASSES / INTRAMURAL BUILDING-INK AREA, per 1,000 sq view units.
